title: Kartel's Hub - 1 Loot To Forge
features:
Kartel's Hub - +1 Loot to Forge Features:

⛏️ Farm:
Feature	Details:
• Auto Train	Core money loop — server-tickets 5+/sec, no fake clicks
• Train delay (ms)	Slider 150–600ms, default 170
• Auto Combat	Drives the game's own skill pipeline (same remotes the UI uses)
• Target first	Dropdown: Auto / Super loot / Boss / Stage enemy / Normal mob
• Auto skills (Q/E)	Casts skills automatically (on by default)
• Close distance	Walks into range before swinging (on by default)
• Auto Stage	Runs the current stage automatically
• Stage	Dropdown: Auto + every stage
• Chain next stage	Chains straight into the next stage (on by default)
• Auto World Boss	Watches for and fights the World Boss

💰 Economy:
Feature	Details:
• Auto Sell	Sells on an interval (10–300s, default 60) + Sell now button
• Auto Rebirth	Fires the rebirth remote the moment the level requirement is met
• Auto Upgrade OrePack	Buys OrePack upgrades as soon as affordable (check every 10–300s, default 30) + Upgrade OrePack now
• Auto Potion	Pops potions on a timer (30–600s, default 300) with a Potion dropdown (TrainPotion, etc.)

🎁 Claims:
Feature	Details:
• Auto claim	One sweep per enable — offline reward, daily season tick, index level rewards
• Claim buttons	Run claim sweep now / Claim offline reward / Claim daily season tick / Claim index level rewards
• Auto redeem codes	Redeems codes from a dropdown (100000CCU, SORRYBUG) + Redeem selected button
• Anti-spam design	Claims run once per enable with pauses between remotes; used codes just come back as messages

⚙️ Misc:
Feature	Details:
• Anti-AFK	Keeps the session alive
• ESP highlights	Super loot = cyan, bosses = magenta, mobs = orange, ores = gold, World Boss = WB marker
• Show overlay HUD	Live power · gain/min · coin · level/rebirth
• Collect ores now	One-shot ore sweep
• Leave current fight (claim)	Escapes the current fight safely

ℹ️ Info:
• Refresh stats now — re-reads Eco (coin / level / power / rebirth) and updates every label
